sources.snippet: DistilBERT is a Free Language model from Hugging Face. Hugging Face's distilled, 40%-smaller version of BERT that retains most of its performance

sources.title: DistilBERT · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: DistilBERT DistilBERT is pretrained by knowledge distillation to create a smaller model with faster inference and requires less compute to train. Through a triple loss objective during pretraining, language modeling loss, distillation loss, cosine-distance loss, DistilBERT demonstrates similar performance to a larger transformer language model.

sources.title: hamzawaheed/emotion-classification-model · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Limitations While the Emotion Classification Model demonstrates strong performance across various tasks, it has certain limitations: Bias in Training Data: The model may inherit biases present in the dair-ai/emotion dataset, potentially affecting its performance across different demographics, cultures, or contexts.

sources.title: shaadclt/Fine-Tuning-DistilBERT-Emotion-Classification - GitHub
sources.snippet: This project demonstrates end-to-end fine-tuning of DistilBERT for emotion classification and its deployment as a production-ready web application. The system transforms raw textual input into emotion predictions using a fine-tuned transformer model, enabling real-time emotional analysis through a clean and lightweight web interface.

sources.title: GitHub - SinaArabi/Emotion-Classification-DistilBERT: This repository ...
sources.snippet: This repository implements a multi-label Emotion Classification system using DistilBERT, a lighter version of BERT. The project spans the complete pipeline, from training the model, deploying it via a FastAPI server, to providing a real-time Streamlit frontend for easy user interaction.
